component.name: The All Dash
component.summary: A command center for a project or a person

description.p: Drop in documents, calendars and spreadsheets and get one live dashboard out of them: what is late, what is blocked, what moved, and what is coming.
Everything is kept on this device. In detail:

ul.li: Boards with twenty-two column kinds, formulas and rules, over the same records as every other view.
A read-later stash that keeps the article text rather than a link, searchable by every word and readable offline.
A media studio: camera, compression, and a player that keeps going when you change view.
Five agents over a memory under selection pressure, every claim carrying the record that supports it.
A focus timer that records its minutes against the task you ran it on.

description.p: The app opens no network connection until you configure something that needs one: fetching a page into the stash, a model provider, or the YouTube embed. With none of those set up it never talks to anything.
